a.lede: Jensen Huang could be back in his old Nvidia office soon as allies rally to push the AI chipmaker to take him back just days after he was ousted over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: Jensen Huang could be plotting return as Nvidia CEO, report claims

b.lede: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
b.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
